title: Add component lineage tags, normalize adaptive auto-layouts, and implement pre-publish safety gate
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Problem: Our Figma library contains many component instances with unclear provenance, inconsistent auto-layout constraints, and a fragile publish pipeline that often causes regressions. Goal: Introduce a lightweight "lineage" tagging convention on master components, normalize adaptive auto-layout usage across control atoms (buttons, table rows, chart legends), and add an automated pre-publish safety gate to catch naming, token, and layout regressions before a library publish. This will reduce post-publish hotfixes, improve designer/engineer handoff, and make rollouts safer for teams relying on the library.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Master components have a standardized lineage tag in the description field and a visible token reference in a dedicated metadata layer
A2: An automated script/plugin identifies and remediates nested fixed-size frames inside auto-layout that block adaptive resizing for 95% of instances in the button and table-row families
A3: Pre-publish gate runs on CI and returns a human-readable report highlighting: token mismatches, orphan instances, variant-count deviations, and auto-layout constraint violations
A4: A canary publish to the 'beta' workspace completes with no high-severity regressions reported by the UX squad within 48 hours
A5: Documentation and a short playbook exist for maintainers to apply lineage tags, run the normalization script, and interpret gate reports
tasks: Audit: sample 200 components across buttons, tables, charts to inventory common auto-layout anti-patterns
Define: lineage tag format (e.g., lineage:component://<team>/<file>/<id> + created_by + version) and where to surface it in component metadata
Prototype: Figma plugin script to insert lineage tags and collect token references into a metadata layer
Normalize: implement AutoLayout normalizer that converts nested fixed frames to stretch constraints where safe
Build: pre-publish gate (Node script + Figma API) that outputs JSON report and human summary
Integrate: wire pre-publish gate into publish CI job + add failsafe bypass for emergency publishes with manual approval
Migrate: run a migration pass on 'beta' workspace and produce a mapping table of changed instances/aliases
Docs: update design system handbook with lineage conventions, publish checklist, and rollback steps
QA: visual diff snapshots and run golden-file comparison for canary publish
Rollout: schedule full publish and post-publish monitoring window (72 hours)
